# Diogo N. Moura

> Strategy executive based in Porto, Portugal. Head of Corporate Strategy & Growth at Mercedes-Benz.io since 2021, after six years in consulting at Accenture (2015 to 2017) and EY (2017 to 2021). Works with a small number of scale-up founders on strategy, programme rescue, operating-model and cost questions.

## What he does

Fractional, advisory or short scoped engagements with scale-up founders. Four kinds of work, and most engagements mix two:

- **Strategic clarity**: frame a hard decision so the founding team can make it, pick the two or three priorities that matter and drop the rest. The output is a written decision with an owner.
- **Programme rescue**: get an off-track programme back under control and into production.
- **Operating model and cost**: who decides what, how teams work together, and the cost base under it.
- **AI adoption**: where AI is worth using in a team, and the governance around it.

## Current role (Mercedes-Benz.io, 2021 to present)

- Leads a team of 7 direct reports across Portugal and Germany, including managers with their own teams.
- Advises the CEO directly, and the CFO/COO weekly on business operations and target operating model.
- Assessed expansion into Eastern Europe and Latin America for the board: market-entry risk, regulation, resourcing.
- Set up the company's Portugal office and the workforce plan behind it; local headcount grew 20% in the first year.
- Owns the staffing pipeline and leads Global Staffing, a forum of senior leaders that forecasts people demand and capacity in a time-and-materials business.
- Brought an off-track Data Warehouse programme back under control and into production.
- Led a cost programme that cut annual costs by 55% (partnership renegotiation, better use of resources, organisational rightsizing).
- Wrote the internal AI strategy and leads its adoption across corporate functions.

## Earlier career

- **EY Consulting, Lisbon (2017 to 2021)**: part of the founding team of the Electricity Sector practice (Portugal, Angola, Mozambique). Wrote a 10-year technology and innovation roadmap for a major electricity utility. Led the PMO for a large software roll-out at a PSI20 company (15+ concurrent projects). Delivered change programmes affecting 3,000+ employees. Improved project margins by 35%.
- **Accenture, Lisbon and Singapore (2015 to 2017)**: Workday HCM roll-out across 25+ countries in Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas; led cross-functional teams in 8 Asia-Pacific countries.

## Education and credentials

- Integrated Master in Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Porto (2009 to 2014)
- Post-graduation in Applied Management with Distinction, NOVA School of Business and Economics (2018 to 2019)
- Certificate in Executive Presence and Influence, INSEAD (2022 to 2023)
- McKinsey Forward Program (2024)
- Claude certifications, Anthropic (2026); Certified SAFe Agilist (2022)

## Side projects

- jobkit: open-source job-search plugin for Claude Code, written in Python, which he maintains (https://github.com/diogonmoura/jobkit).
- A homelab he has run for eight years.

## Languages and location

Portuguese (native), English (full proficiency), Spanish (basic). Based in Porto, Portugal; works with founders anywhere.
